name: Moonfolk
description: Enigmatic flying humanoid race of Kamigawa dwelling in the clouds, claiming descent from a moon Myojin.

description_citations.text: "Moonfolk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Konda performs an arcane ritual with moonfolk and wizard allies and kidnaps O-Kagachi's child, imprisoning it in a stone disk.
timeline.quote: Konda tore the god-child out of the spirit realm and brought it into the physical world

citation.text: "Kami War", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Kami War era, Mochi and the soratami secretly plot to make the soratami dominant by manipulating Konda into inciting war between mortals and kami; the effort fails.
timeline.quote: However, these efforts would ultimately fail.

citation.text: "Moonfolk", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Kamigawa's Modern Age the moonfolk open Otawara to outsiders and it becomes a center of innovation.
timeline.quote: opening Otawara to outsiders (though still not Oboro palace itself), and allowing the city to become a center of innovation

citation.text: "Moonfolk", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The moonfolk establish the Saiba Futurists and ask the dragon kami Kairi to protect Otawara, but Kairi refuses.
timeline.quote: the moonfolk asked the dragon kami Kairi to protect their city, only for the great kami to refuse

citation.text: "Moonfolk", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Forced by the soratami's revenge, Toshi reverses the spell, kills Uyo with her power and frees the yuki-onna to her original realm.
timeline.quote: Then, he broke the final kanji, and the yuki-onna was reinstated in her original realm again.
